cues.show: You standing or sitting tall, the circle on screen before Start.
cues.say: This is a breathing exercise for singing. There is no microphone and nothing to sing.

cues.show: Point at the circle, the count in the middle, the strip of phases under it.
cues.say: The circle grows while you breathe in, stays while you hold, and shrinks while you breathe out. The number in the middle counts each one.

cues.show: Point at the circle, the count in the middle, the strip of phases under it.
cues.say: The strip under it shows what comes next.

cues.show: You from the side: a hand on the belly, breathing in and out.
cues.say: Put a hand on your belly. When you breathe in, the hand moves out and your ribs open to the sides. Your shoulders stay down.

cues.show: Press Start in the circle and follow a few rounds.
cues.say: Press Start in the circle. It first asks you to breathe out fully, then the rounds begin.

cues.show: Press Start in the circle and follow a few rounds.
cues.say: Breathe in through your nose and out through your mouth, as slowly as the circle moves.

cues.show: Stop, breathe normally for a moment.
cues.say: _Stop and breathe normally if you feel dizzy._

cues.show: Stop, breathe normally for a moment.
cues.say: A break is always fine. The goal of this practice is a breath out that is even from the first count to the last.

cues.show: Breathe out on a hiss, then on a hum. Do a round lying down or with hands on the ribs.
cues.say: Try things with it. Breathe out on a long quiet hiss and keep the sound even.

cues.show: Breathe out on a hiss, then on a hum. Do a round lying down or with hands on the ribs.
cues.say: Breathe out on a hum, and feel where the sound starts.

cues.show: Breathe out on a hiss, then on a hum. Do a round lying down or with hands on the ribs.
cues.say: Put your hands on the sides of your ribs and feel them open as you breathe in.

cues.show: Breathe out on a hiss, then on a hum. Do a round lying down or with hands on the ribs.
cues.say: The bell button turns the ticking off if you want silence.
